data.name: Shardana
data.detailed_description:
🗿 SHARDANA

You don't quite remember who you were before the storm. All that's left is the feeling of having been a Shardana, a warrior tied to something you can barely bring into focus now.

You wake up on an unfamiliar beach, clothes still soaked, and quickly realize you're not alone on this island. There are villages tucked among the rocks, abandoned gardens, boats pulled up on the shore — signs of people who lived here until recently, and who've now gone into hiding or vanished entirely.

Something woke up beneath these stones. And it's hungry. 🌑

The people you meet aren't all the same — some eye you with suspicion, others with a flicker of hope. You can help them, heal them, earn their trust. Or leave them to whatever's coming for them. The island keeps score, one way or another.

By day, the island is yours. Fish along the coast, hunt in the woods, tend a garden, take the boat out to see what's beyond the shores no one visits anymore. Build, repair, get yourself ready for what comes after sunset.

Because once the sun goes down, the rules change.

Shadows start moving before it's even fully dark. The quiet spots from daytime turn into traps. Your shelter gets tested every night by whatever the infestation has created — and you won't always have to face it alone. 🔥

The deeper you go, the more you realize you're not just trying to survive: you're bringing back to light a civilization that time buried on purpose. The Nuragic people weren't just postcard ruins. They were a real people. And maybe you're the last one still carrying their blood.

SHARDANA. An island to explore by day, to fear by night, and a Sardinian story that deserved to be told.

🎮 What's in the game

🌊 Survival

  • Fishing and hunting for food

  • Gardening and crop growing

  • Crafting tools, weapons, and shelters

  • Ship voyages between the island's regions

🩸 Survival Horror

  • Day/night cycle, with NPCs transforming at sundown

  • Night raids: waves of corrupted creatures besieging your shelter

  • Fire and light as your only real defense in the dark

🤝 Social

  • Reputation with surviving inhabitants: help them, heal them, or leave them behind

  • Co-op mode

🗿 Narrative

  • Nuragic setting: nuraghi, giants' tombs, ancient rituals

  • A Shardana protagonist searching for a lost identity

  • A mystery tied to one of the most fascinating and least-told civilizations of the Mediterranean

data.short_description: 🌊 SHARDANA is a survival horror game set in Nuragic Sardinia. Shipwrecked on a mysterious island, you must survive, explore, and find a cure for a terrifying infestation. But beware of the night: that’s when the monsters emerge. 🌙🗿
